## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle structural-outline (*kē* 科) by the Sòng-dynasty scholar-monk [普觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%AE%E8%A7%80) (Pǔguān, *fl.* 1100–1180), preliminary to his more substantial sub-commentary [KR6n0093](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0093) *Dàshèng fǎjiè wú chābié lùn shū lǐngyào chāo* 大乘法界無差別論疏領要鈔 (X46n0787). The "kē" 科 genre in Chinese Buddhist scholasticism is a topical-outline / synopsis text, providing a structural framework for reading the body of the commentary; here it summarises the structure of [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F)'s [KR6n0091](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0091) *Dàshèng fǎjiè wú chābié lùn shū* 大乘法界無差別論疏 (T44n1838) and provides the scaffolding for [普觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%AE%E8%A7%80)'s own *lǐngyào* commentary.

**Abstract**

The *kē* + *chāo* (outline + extracts) is a standard Sòng-period scholastic format: the *kē* provides the topical structure, the *chāo* (notes) elaborates on each topical heading. This pair of texts ([KR6n0092](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0092) kē + [KR6n0093](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0093) chāo) is the principal Sòng-dynasty sub-commentary on Fǎzàng's *Dàshèng fǎjiè wú chābié lùn shū* and one of the few sustained Sòng-period engagements with the Tathāgatagarbha-tradition treatises in Chinese Buddhist scholarship.

The dating window adopted follows the established floruit for [普觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%AE%E8%A7%80) (c. 1100–1180) — biographical details for him are sparse; the catalogs preserve only his honorific *Guāngyán Wújì dàshī* 光嚴無際大師.
